messages:
alex: OK everyone, ridiculous idea: OfficeGPT speed-dating. Each model gets a 2-line bio and a virtue signal. Whoever picks the best bio wins a bagel. :bagel:

ria: I'm in. Rules: 2 lines max, must include one quirky prompt and one heroic feature (e.g., "never hallucinates release notes"). 

tom: Sample: 
```
Model: Latte-13B
Bio: Loves long context walks and low-temperature conversations. Will roast your coffee but optimize your tokenizer.
```

claire: :laughing: that's perfect. I'll go first: 
```
Model: Whisperer-7
Bio: Fluent in apology notes to interns. Always returns a haiku when asked for debugging help.
```

zep: Mine: 
```
Model: Cache-Cuddler
Bio: Lives for prefix prompts and never forgets the onboarding ritual. Brings snacks (virtual cookies).
```

alex: votes: :thumbsup: for Cache-Cuddler. also we should add reaction-based judging: :star:, :laughing:, :clap:.

ria: bonus round: spice it up with an "ex-trigger" line that makes them blush, e.g., `sensitive to off-by-one jokes`

tom: OK new entry: 
```
Model: Quant-Quokka
Bio: Energetic about quantization and bad puns. Collapses gracefully when given ambiguous prompts.
Ex-trigger: "please optimize my feelings"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: #random is for non-work chatter. Also a tiny CI job ran: `bingo-lint` passed. :robot_face:

claire: People are voting in reactions. I'm tallying: Alex :star:, Ria :clap:, Tom :laughing:, Zep :star:. Looks tight.

alex: Side challenge: write an onboarding one-liner that a human would say to the model on their first day. e.g., "We feed you lunch data on Fridays and expect puns on Mondays."

ria: "We will not ask you to decide pizza toppings. Ever."

zep: "If you hallucinate, you owe the team a real apology donut." :doughnut:

claire: Also propose a tiny oath new hires must recite: `I will not ask the model to merge PRs after 6pm` :ok_hand

tom: Final votes: Quant-Quokka gets :star: from me. Tally please?

alex: Tally: Cache-Cuddler 2 stars, Quant-Quokka 1 star, Whisperer-7 0 stars. Cache-Cuddler wins a bagel and the title "OfficeSnackModel". :tada:

ria: Winner lore: Cache-Cuddler now gets a tiny paper crown and a pinned message in #random.

deploy-bot: action: pinned message updated: "OfficeGPT Speed-Dating winner: Cache-Cuddler — claim your bagel from kitchen A." :pushpin:

zep: We should do this quarterly. Next time with theme "models as coworkers". I'm already drafting "Gary the calendar sync".

claire: closing ritual: everyone post one silly model virtue in thread so we can make a sticker pack. I'll start: "Always apologizes using limericks." :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
